name: Dual Thrust daily range breakout (long/short)
one_line: Close breaks open +/- K*range(4-bar) -> trade breakout direction; best blind-period candidate in owner's catalog.

source.license: no LICENSE file in repo; owner's own repository (owner-provided reference, do not redistribute)

idea: Range-expansion breakout. Range = max(HH-LC, HC-LL) over previous 4 bars (HH highest high, LC lowest close, HC highest close, LL lowest low, all shifted by 1). Long when close > open + K*range, short when close < open - K*range.

rules.name: upper_breakout_entry
rules.description: close > open + K*range4 (range from prior 4 bars only)

rules.name: lower_breakout_exit
rules.description: long/flat adaptation: go flat when close < open - K*range4

rationale: Volatility-breakout momentum; event study 10d edge +1.09pp, 20d edge +2.17pp across the universe.
evidence: Portfolio (0.05%/side fees, no funding/slippage): full CAGR +53.8%, MDD 34.5%, Sharpe 1.42, 909 trades; blind 2024-26 CAGR +57.7%, MDD 31.9%, Sharpe 1.51. Year returns: 2020 -1.4%, 2022 -14.1%.
limitations: no funding or slippage in the source numbers
K=0.7 variant collapses (CAGR 38.9%, MDD 48.9%) -> parameter sensitive
single configuration among ~142 tested -> selection bias
source is a cross-sectional market-neutral portfolio; single-asset long/flat will differ

pipeline_fit.notes: Use only the long side on BTC or ETH; treat K as fixed a-priori (0.5), do not tune.
